name: Page
title: Page (free HTML pages)
description: A free page: one complete HTML document the agent writes, index.html in the artifact's own folder with any files beside it, opened as a live local page. The page can keep a small shared database, upload and list files, hand the viewer a file to save, read who is viewing, broadcast to other open views and take comments, through the runtime capabilities the agent declares when it creates or updates the artifact.
summary: A free HTML page with the runtime capabilities you declare: a tool, a mini game, an explainer page.
when: The person wants a small interactive page that no other installed type fits: a widget or tool, a calculator, a mini game, an explainer page, a poll, checklist or sign-up sheet that remembers what people do on it.
